title: "Worse Than Credit Cards?” - Buy Now Pay Later Exposed
summary: Trading-show panel debating whether BNPL is worse than credit cards, covering its fee structure and regulatory loopholes.

assertions.quote: you miss one payment of the three... the interest rate goes to what 30% on the entire purchase

soft credit check... they're not doing a full-blown credit check on you

the online retailer has turned to bnpl to solve a marketing problem which is online cart abandonment

verdicts.note: Retailers and analysts have described buy now pay later partly as a conversion tool to recover abandoned carts, alongside its financing function.
NBER: making BNPL generally available at an e-commerce retailer increased total conversions by 9 percentage points (13% relative), confirming its role as a conversion tool.
CFPB: BNPL lenders promote BNPL to retailers explicitly as an 'incremental sales' and conversion tool, citing a '30% increase in conversion' among their marketing pitch to merchants.
